bounds: Only the canonical Python request is accepted. The agent cannot set model coefficients, validator policy, code, filesystem destination, timeout, or uncertainty scope used for the primary recommendation.
observability: Per-call directory under the server-owned audit root: request, strict decision JSON, HTML card, worker stdout/stderr, invocation metadata and SHA manifest. Summary contains the admitted primary recommendation; conditional and deferred results are diagnostics only.
agent_contract: Do not invent observations, publication timestamps, health, provenance, units, or bindings. Missing data must remain unknown. Never promote a conditional/deferred plan or an invalid response to the primary recommendation. Explain model assumptions and use exact tool evidence. No plant actuation or file-edit tools are exposed.
acceptance: End-to-end tool call runs the existing Python cycle in a child process and matches direct API results on the seven original presets.
Previously unused transfer inputs vary horizon, step, stocks and raw-material quality; wrapper and direct API agree without changing the evaluator.
Reject unknown tools, extra parameters, nonfinite/duplicate-key JSON, requests above the fixed size and attempts to weaken the sulfur cap or override policy.
No-result and conditional-only cases retain null primary recommendation.
Worker timeout or exception produces a tool error and an auditable failed call; no stale recommendation is reused.
Demonstrate a protocol client discovering the tool and sending JSON to obtain a result, plus saved trace and artifact integrity checks.
language_model_evaluation: A model provider/client is not selected yet. Protocol and deterministic tool integration can be tested without an external LLM; do not describe this as proof of agent reasoning quality.
rollback: Stop or remove the tool server connection; the Python cycle and frozen reports remain callable unchanged.
